Hi Priyanka —

Great speaking with you yesterday. We're excited to extend an offer for the Senior Software Engineer role on the Inference runtime team. Attached is the draft offer (Redwood_Offer_Priyanka_Sood_v1.pdf) — it includes base comp, target equity grant, sign-on, and standard benefits.

Two quick items I want to align on before we send the DocuSign envelope:
- Start date: our initial target was Aug 30. Do you have any constraints (relocation, visa, notice period) that would require a later date?
- Routing: we generally route the envelope to candidate -> hiring manager (Laura) -> HR (Tessa) for countersign. If you'd like a recruiter copy or a separate legal review, we can include additional recipients.

If this looks good, I can update the start date and send a DocuSign link tomorrow.

Attachment: Redwood_Offer_Priyanka_Sood_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Team —

Priyanka asked to move start from Aug 30 to Sept 20 and asked a question about equity vesting commencement vs. sign-on timing. Can we accommodate Sept 20? Notes:
- Laura: manager impact on ramp / project start?
- Vivek: will a one-month push affect hiring cadence or approvals?
- Tessa/HR: can we route the DocuSign envelope with the adjusted start date and include a note on equity vest timing (we typically start vesting from first day, but we can discuss an accelerated sign-on payout to ease cashflow for relocation).

I chatted briefly with HR and they suggested offering a $7k relocation stipend (manual reimbursement) if we keep base & equity unchanged. That keeps comp math intact and helps candidate. I've attached a short relocation summary we can edit.

Attachment: Relocation_Stipend_Summary.pdf (application/pdf)
